items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment. Approve no new spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, or unsupported revenue claims. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The $4.92 aggregate row is not site-attributable; reported site-attributed commission is $0, which does not prove zero site performance. AI usage reports $886.12 across 4,865 calls from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable: revenue and cost periods do not align; infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, experiment-cost, and approved-budget records are incomplete; monthly budget limits and a learning-outcome threshold are blank. Continue only existing period-aligned attribution and cost reconciliation using recorded telemetry. Do not treat impressions, rankings, clicks, sessions, conversions, orders, shipped items, or AI usage as financial return or causal lift. Minimum measurement: period-aligned attributable revenue by site, content, and tracking ID; reconciled AI-cost ledger; infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, experiment-cost, and approved-budget records; and an explicit cost-to-learn threshold.

CFO handoff: retain the existing repair-or-close, deterministic validation, rollback, deduplication, measurement reconciliation, and bounded legal/security evidence work. Defer all new proposals, queue work, experiments, telemetry, deployments, requeues, dependencies, spending, commitments, and monetization changes. Preserve the $4.92 aggregate commission as unattributed and retain contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, budget capacity, and causal lift as unknown.
